title: Granola
description: Paper and ink: a white page, a warm oat surface for windows and cards, ink-black text and pills, warm greys and olive hairlines. A dark olive for the main CTA, a lime band for emphasis, and a pastel rainbow reserved for text shimmers. A light editorial serif for every heading over a neutral grotesque; pills, 16px windows, 4px media.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the charcoal bands (logo wall, testimonials) carry the dark class themselves
highlight is the lime band colour; chart-1…5 are the shimmer stops (amber, pink, lilac, sky, lime); chart-4 doubles as the chat chip's pale blue
Newsreader stands in for Quadrant (low-contrast editorial serif, large x-height); Instrument Sans for Melange (warm neo-grotesque)
